CRITICAL.description: Direct or realistically exploitable loss of user or protocol funds, unbounded bad debt, unauthorized mint or upgrade authority, permanent protocol insolvency, or oracle/manipulation path that can drain collateral or JPYdf value.
examples: Unauthorized minting or burning of JPYdf or dToken
CollateralVault accounting permits redeeming more underlying than backed
Oracle stale or backing-ratio bypass enables undercollateralized borrowing
Governance or UUPS control can be seized without the intended Timelock or owner path

HIGH.description: Material fund loss or lockup under plausible conditions, privileged action bypass, branch-level liquidation/redemption failure, strategy loss handling failure, or persistent accounting desynchronization requiring governance rescue.
examples: Delayed redeem or claim can be blocked for a class of users
Strategy sendToVault or writeoff flow can desynchronize principal and assets
Pause or guardian controls can freeze the wrong surface or fail to stop deposits
Zapper slippage or receiver routing can move user value to an unintended destination

MEDIUM.description: Scoped denial of service, bounded accounting drift, incorrect event or monitoring state that can mislead operations, griefing with material cost asymmetry, or recoverable governance/configuration failure.
examples: Allocator limits or cooldowns can be bypassed in a bounded way
Expected monitoring event is missing or emitted with ambiguous data
InterestRouter route can be griefed into repeated failed keeper attempts
Inactive placeholder branch can be confused with active collateral in a non-fund-loss path

LOW.description: Code quality, documentation, non-critical observability, minor UX/security hardening, or low-impact edge cases with clear manual recovery.
examples: Ambiguous revert reason or missing event for an admin-only path
Dead code or stale interface increases audit noise
Non-critical frontend or ops mismatch with no direct on-chain safety impact

scope_notes: Initial SPECA pilot for JPY DeFi. Focus on DeltaForesight-owned Solidity behavior and spec-to-implementation mismatches. Liquity v2 core is only in scope where JPY DeFi-specific CORE-MOD or boundary assumptions are referenced by the in-scope layers. Do not include secrets, RPC URLs, private keys, or .env content in prompts or reports.
